reviews.comment: Approved. Feature works and is verified live (detection, both write modes, git check-ignore, idempotency, non-git no-op). No blockers. Non-blocking: (1) .git-as-file worktree/submodule breaks local mode — handled via warning but folder not ignored; recommend statSync isDirectory guard. (2) unanchored <slug>/ rule — recommend /<slug>/. (3) exact-match idempotency, (4) cosmetic blank line. Security: LOW symlink-following write, mitigated by trusted-request gate.

Round 2 re-review: all 4 Round-1 non-blocking findings fixed and re-verified live (worktree local now writes common info/exclude and git check-ignore confirms; anchored /slug/; anchor-aware idempotency; no leading blank line). No new blockers. Updated the LOW symlink note: local write target now also derives from gitlink gitdir/commondir content — same trust boundary, still LOW/optional. Approved.

Round 3 re-review of the hardening pass. Both Round-2 non-blocking items fixed and re-verified live: symlink-refusal uses lstat (catches dangling symlinks; ENOENT safe; rethrows EACCES) and stale-gitlink returns null -> honest warning. Regression (worktree local, anchoring, idempotency, non-git no-op) all hold; tsc/lint/build green. No new blockers. One accepted LOW residual: intermediate-component symlinks in local mode remain within the same trust boundary and are intentionally not confined (would break cross-root worktrees). Approved.
Human approved (Project Owner). Follow-up: install global + restart master.
